title: Discord Kitten
blurb: Few phrases summon a more specific mental image than Discord kitten. The meme concerns Nitro gifts flowing one way and affection flowing the other, and it is filed permanently under cursed. This audio lets you make the accusation without typing it, which is faster and considerably funnier. Use it when somebody boosts a server suspiciously quickly, when a gift arrives with no explanation attached, or when a voice chat needs derailing inside a second. Certain allegations cannot be walked back, and the group chat has an extremely long memory.
origin: From the 'Discord kitten' meme about Nitro-fueled server dynamics.
